name: Tokyo Plast International Limited
about: Tokyo Plast International Limited manufactures and sells thermo food containers and coolers in India, the United States, Australia, and internationally. It offers plastic thermoware products, as well as houseware products; and insulated water jugs, ice chest, insulated casseroles, and food warmers. The company serves plastic industry. Tokyo Plast International Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.
